pre.speaker: narrator
pre.text: The pass road climbs between wooded hills to a stockade of sharpened logs. Two chiefs hold it: Pei Yuanshao, and a dark giant with an axe.

pre.speaker: pei-yuanshao
pre.text: The road is ours and so is the toll. Turn back or pay it in blood.

pre.speaker: zhou-cang
pre.text: Is that Guan Yu? I have heard of him. I would rather follow a man like that than rob him.

pre.speaker: guan-yu
pre.text: Then lay down the axe and come over. Brother, he means it.

pre.speaker: liu-bei
pre.text: Break Pei Yuanshao, and speak to the giant if you can reach him. I would rather win the man than the pass.

post.speaker: narrator
post.text: Pei Yuanshao's bandits scatter into the hills, and the pass road lies open.

post.speaker: liu-bei
post.text: Their hoard feeds the band for a week. The road is free for every cart behind us.

post.speaker: zhang-fei
post.text: And if the giant came over, I have someone to drink with who can keep up.
